title: Access probe registry
description: The catalogue of read-only readiness checks, one per route plus a few control-plane self-checks. Probes are strictly non-mutating and prove which identity answered without printing any secret value.

probe_id.description: Stable identifier referenced by a route's access_probe_id.

command.description: A concrete, strictly non-mutating command. The mutating subcommands of the tool being probed are asserted absent by contract tests.

expected_signal.description: What a pass looks like, normally including the requirement that no token value is printed.

safe_lane.description: What the probe itself costs and touches, so the router can reason about the price of proving readiness.

default_ttl_ms.description: How long the result stays fresh. Local credential checks carry a long time-to-live; network- or state-volatile checks a short one.

scope.description: The route or subsystem this probe proves.
